huggies-month-overview.sql:
WITH HX AS (
  SELECT AD.STAT_COST_FOR_ROI2 AS cost, AD.TOTAL_PAY_ORDER_GMV_INCLUDE_COUPON_FOR_ROI2 AS gmv,
         AD.TOTAL_PAY_ORDER_COUNT_FOR_ROI2 AS ord, AD.ADDITIONAL_DELIVERY_STAT_COST_FOR_ROI2_ASSIST AS addl,
         AD.MATERIAL_ID, AD.STAT_TIME
  FROM 千川素材数据_素材列表 AD
  INNER JOIN video_management.dbo.QC_MONTAGE_MATERIAL_VIDEO_DATA D ON D.ADVERTISER_ID=AD.ADVERTISER_ID AND D.MATERIAL_ID=AD.MATERIAL_ID
  INNER JOIN video_management.dbo.QC_MONTAGE_VIDEO_PROD_TAG VPT ON D.ID=VPT.VIDEO_ID
  INNER JOIN video_management.dbo.QC_MONTAGE_PRODUCT P ON P.PROD_ID=VPT.PROD_ID
  WHERE VPT.STATE='1' AND P.STATE='1' AND P.BRAND_ID=1
)
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(cost),0) AS total_cost,
  ROUND(SUM(gmv),0) AS total_gmv,
  SUM(ord) AS total_orders,
  ROUND(SUM(gmv)/NULLIF(SUM(cost),0),2) AS overall_roi,
  ROUND(SUM(addl),0) AS addl_cost,
  ROUND(SUM(addl)/NULLIF(SUM(cost),0),4) AS addl_ratio,
  COUNT(DISTINCT MATERIAL_ID) AS active_mats,
  CONVERT(varchar(10), (SELECT MAX(STAT_TIME) FROM HX), 23) AS data_date
FROM HX
WHERE STAT_TIME >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR((SELECT MAX(STAT_TIME) FROM HX)), MONTH((SELECT MAX(STAT_TIME) FROM HX)), 1)
huggies-month-overview.title: 好奇纸尿裤 · 本月总览

huggies-dim-summary.sql:
WITH HX AS (
  SELECT AD.ADVERTISER_ID, AD.MATERIAL_ID, AD.STAT_TIME, AD.STAT_COST_FOR_ROI2 AS cost,
         AD.TOTAL_PREPAY_AND_PAY_ORDER_ROI2 AS roi,
         AD.ADDITIONAL_DELIVERY_STAT_COST_FOR_ROI2_ASSIST AS addl,
         P.PROD_NAME AS prod_name, P.ROI_QUALIFIED_BASELINE AS bl, P.DAILY_SPEND_BASELINE AS dbl
  FROM 千川素材数据_素材列表 AD
  INNER JOIN video_management.dbo.QC_MONTAGE_MATERIAL_VIDEO_DATA D ON D.ADVERTISER_ID=AD.ADVERTISER_ID AND D.MATERIAL_ID=AD.MATERIAL_ID
  INNER JOIN video_management.dbo.QC_MONTAGE_VIDEO_PROD_TAG VPT ON D.ID=VPT.VIDEO_ID
  INNER JOIN video_management.dbo.QC_MONTAGE_PRODUCT P ON P.PROD_ID=VPT.PROD_ID
  WHERE VPT.STATE='1' AND P.STATE='1' AND P.BRAND_ID=1
),
TD AS (
  SELECT ADVERTISER_ID, MATERIAL_ID, MAX(prod_name) AS prod_name, MAX(bl) AS bl, MAX(dbl) AS dbl,
    MAX(cost) AS cost, MAX(roi) AS roi, MAX(addl) AS addl
  FROM HX WHERE STAT_TIME = (SELECT MAX(STAT_TIME) FROM HX)
  GROUP BY ADVERTISER_ID, MATERIAL_ID
),
LASTACT AS (
  SELECT ADVERTISER_ID, MATERIAL_ID, MAX(STAT_TIME) AS last_dt
  FROM HX WHERE cost > 0 GROUP BY ADVERTISER_ID, MATERIAL_ID
),
FULLD AS (
  SELECT TD.*, CASE WHEN LA.last_dt >= DATEADD(day,-1,(SELECT MAX(STAT_TIME) FROM HX)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_active
  FROM TD LEFT JOIN LASTACT LA ON TD.ADVERTISER_ID=LA.ADVERTISER_ID AND TD.MATERIAL_ID=LA.MATERIAL_ID
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_active=1 AND roi>=bl AND cost>=dbl AND (addl IS NULL OR addl=0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS should_add,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_active=1 AND roi>=bl AND cost>=dbl AND (addl IS NULL OR addl=0) THEN cost*CASE WHEN roi/bl>3 THEN 3 ELSE roi/bl END ELSE 0 END),0) AS should_add_est,
  SUM(CASE WHEN roi<bl AND addl>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wrong_add,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN roi<bl AND addl>0 THEN addl ELSE 0 END),0) AS wrong_add_waste,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_active=1 AND roi>=bl AND cost>=dbl AND addl>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ok_add,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_active=1 AND (roi<1 OR (cost>=100 AND roi<bl*0.5)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_running,
  SUM(is_active) AS active_mats
FROM FULLD
huggies-dim-summary.title: 好奇纸尿裤 · 九维诊断（当日）

top-materials-cvr.sql:
WITH anchor AS (
  SELECT MAX(STAT_TIME) AS max_date FROM dbo.[千川素材数据_素材列表]
)
SELECT TOP 8
  CAST(MATERIAL_ID AS varchar(30)) AS material_id,
  MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(MATERIAL_NAME, ''), '未命名素材')) AS material_name,
  MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(MATERIAL_SOURCE, ''), '未知来源')) AS material_source,
  SUM(COALESCE(STAT_COST_FOR_ROI2, 0)) AS spend,
  SUM(COALESCE(TOTAL_PAY_ORDER_GMV_INCLUDE_COUPON_FOR_ROI2, 0)) AS gmv,
  SUM(COALESCE(TOTAL_PAY_ORDER_COUNT_FOR_ROI2, 0)) AS orders,
  SUM(COALESCE(VIDEO_PLAY_COUNT_FOR_ROI2_V2, 0)) AS plays,
  SUM(
    COALESCE(VIDEO_LIKE_COUNT_FOR_ROI2, 0)
    + COALESCE(VIDEO_COMMENT_COUNT_FOR_ROI2_V2, 0)
    + COALESCE(VIDEO_FOLLOW_COUNT_FOR_ROI2, 0)
  ) AS engagements,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(COALESCE(VIDEO_PLAY_COUNT_FOR_ROI2_V2, 0)) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(TOTAL_PAY_ORDER_COUNT_FOR_ROI2, 0)) / SUM(COALESCE(VIDEO_PLAY_COUNT_FOR_ROI2_V2, 0)), 2)
  END AS 转化率
FROM dbo.[千川素材数据_素材列表]
CROSS JOIN anchor
WHERE STAT_TIME >= DATEADD(day, -6, anchor.max_date)
  AND STAT_TIME < DATEADD(day, 1, anchor.max_date)
GROUP BY MATERIAL_ID
HAVING SUM(COALESCE(STAT_COST_FOR_ROI2, 0)) > 0
ORDER BY spend DESC
top-materials-cvr.title: 近7日高消耗素材（含转化率）

zhuigou-summary.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    M.ADVERTISER_ID, M.MATERIAL_ID,
    MAX(P.ROI_QUALIFIED_BASELINE) AS baseline, MAX(P.DAILY_SPEND_BASELINE) AS spend_base,
    MAX(M.STAT_COST_FOR_ROI2) AS spend, MAX(M.TOTAL_PREPAY_AND_PAY_ORDER_ROI2) AS roi,
    MAX(COALESCE(M.ADDITIONAL_DELIVERY_STAT_COST_FOR_ROI2_ASSIST,0)) AS add_cost
  FROM dbo.[千川素材数据_素材列表] M
  INNER JOIN video_management.dbo.QC_MONTAGE_MATERIAL_VIDEO_DATA D ON M.ADVERTISER_ID = D.ADVERTISER_ID AND M.MATERIAL_ID = D.MATERIAL_ID
  INNER JOIN video_management.dbo.QC_MONTAGE_VIDEO_PROD_TAG VPT ON D.ID = VPT.VIDEO_ID
  INNER JOIN video_management.dbo.QC_MONTAGE_PRODUCT P ON VPT.PROD_ID = P.PROD_ID
  WHERE M.STAT_TIME = (SELECT TOP 1 STAT_TIME FROM dbo.[千川素材数据_素材列表] ORDER BY STAT_TIME DESC)
    AND P.STATE = '1' AND M.STAT_COST_FOR_ROI2 > 0
  GROUP BY M.ADVERTISER_ID, M.MATERIAL_ID
)
SELECT
  (SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(varchar(10), STAT_TIME, 23) FROM dbo.[千川素材数据_素材列表] ORDER BY STAT_TIME DESC) AS anchor_date,
  COUNT(*) AS total_mats,
  ROUND(SUM(spend),0) AS total_spend,
  ROUND(SUM(add_cost),0) AS total_addcost,
  ROUND(SUM(add_cost)*100/NULLIF(SUM(spend),0),1) AS addcost_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN roi >= baseline AND spend >= spend_base AND add_cost = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d1_cnt,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN roi >= baseline AND spend >= spend_base AND add_cost = 0 THEN spend * (CASE WHEN roi/NULLIF(baseline,0) > 3 THEN 3 ELSE roi/NULLIF(baseline,0) END) ELSE 0 END),0) AS d1_inc,
  SUM(CASE WHEN roi < baseline AND add_cost > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d2_cnt,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN roi < baseline AND add_cost > 0 THEN add_cost ELSE 0 END),0) AS d2_waste,
  SUM(CASE WHEN roi >= baseline AND spend >= spend_base AND add_cost > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d3_cnt,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN roi >= baseline AND spend >= spend_base AND add_cost > 0 THEN add_cost ELSE 0 END),0) AS d3_addcost,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (roi < baseline OR spend < spend_base) AND add_cost = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d4_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN roi < 1.0 OR (spend >= 100 AND roi < baseline*0.5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d6_cnt,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN roi < 1.0 OR (spend >= 100 AND roi < baseline*0.5) THEN spend ELSE 0 END),0) AS d6_spend
FROM base
zhuigou-summary.title: 追投九维汇总（当日口径）

zhuigou-plan.sql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT TASK_ID,
    MAX(CONTROL_STAT) AS control_stat, MAX(BUDGET) AS budget,
    MAX(STAT_COST_FOR_OVERALL_ROI2_ASSIST) AS spend,
    MAX(TOTAL_PREPAY_AND_PAY_ORDER_ROI2_ASSIST) AS roi,
    MAX(PAY_ROI2_GOAL) AS goal
  FROM dbo.[千川素材数据_乘方_调控]
  WHERE CONVERT(varchar(10), DATE_TIME, 23) = (SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(varchar(10), STAT_TIME, 23) FROM dbo.[千川素材数据_素材列表] ORDER BY STAT_TIME DESC)
  GROUP BY TASK_ID
),
run AS (
  SELECT * FROM p
  WHERE control_stat NOT LIKE '%已暂停%' AND control_stat NOT IN ('已完成','已终止','关联直播间未开播')
)
SELECT
  (SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(varchar(10), STAT_TIME, 23) FROM dbo.[千川素材数据_素材列表] ORDER BY STAT_TIME DESC) AS anchor_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM p) AS total_plans,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM run) AS running_plans,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM p WHERE control_stat LIKE '%已暂停%' OR control_stat IN ('已完成','已终止','关联直播间未开播')) AS stopped_plans,
  SUM(CASE WHEN roi >= goal AND ABS(spend-budget) < 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d5a_cnt,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN roi >= goal AND ABS(spend-budget) < 1 THEN spend ELSE 0 END),0) AS d5a_spend,
  SUM(CASE WHEN roi < goal AND spend > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d5b_cnt,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN roi < goal AND spend > 0 THEN spend ELSE 0 END),0) AS d5b_spend,
  SUM(CASE WHEN roi >= goal AND ABS(spend-budget) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d5c_cnt
FROM run
zhuigou-plan.title: 追投计划执行汇总（当日口径）

zhuigou-miss-candidates.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    M.ADVERTISER_ID, M.MATERIAL_ID,
    MAX(M.MATERIAL_NAME) AS mat_name,
    MAX(P.PROD_ID) AS prod_id, MAX(P.PROD_NAME) AS prod_name,
    MAX(P.ROI_QUALIFIED_BASELINE) AS baseline, MAX(P.DAILY_SPEND_BASELINE) AS spend_base,
    MAX(M.STAT_COST_FOR_ROI2) AS spend, MAX(M.TOTAL_PREPAY_AND_PAY_ORDER_ROI2) AS roi,
    MAX(COALESCE(M.ADDITIONAL_DELIVERY_STAT_COST_FOR_ROI2_ASSIST,0)) AS add_cost
  FROM dbo.[千川素材数据_素材列表] M
  INNER JOIN video_management.dbo.QC_MONTAGE_MATERIAL_VIDEO_DATA D ON M.ADVERTISER_ID = D.ADVERTISER_ID AND M.MATERIAL_ID = D.MATERIAL_ID
  INNER JOIN video_management.dbo.QC_MONTAGE_VIDEO_PROD_TAG VPT ON D.ID = VPT.VIDEO_ID
  INNER JOIN video_management.dbo.QC_MONTAGE_PRODUCT P ON VPT.PROD_ID = P.PROD_ID
  WHERE M.STAT_TIME = (SELECT TOP 1 STAT_TIME FROM dbo.[千川素材数据_素材列表] ORDER BY STAT_TIME DESC)
    AND P.STATE = '1' AND M.STAT_COST_FOR_ROI2 > 0
  GROUP BY M.ADVERTISER_ID, M.MATERIAL_ID
)
SELECT TOP 20
  mat_name AS 素材名, prod_name AS 品线, ROUND(baseline,2) AS 基线ROI,
  ROUND(spend,2) AS 当日消耗, ROUND(roi,2) AS 当日ROI,
  ROUND(spend * (CASE WHEN roi/NULLIF(baseline,0) > 3 THEN 3 ELSE roi/NULLIF(baseline,0) END),0) AS 预估日增
FROM base
WHERE roi >= baseline AND spend >= spend_base AND add_cost = 0
ORDER BY 预估日增 DESC

  SUM(CASE WHEN roi >= baseline AND spend >= spend_base AND add_cost = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d1_cnt,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN roi >= baseline AND spend >= spend_base AND add_cost = 0 THEN spend * (CASE WHEN roi/baseline > 3 THEN 3 ELSE roi/baseline END) ELSE 0 END),0) AS d1_est,

  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN roi < baseline AND add_cost > 0 THEN add_cost ELSE 0 END),0) AS d2_waste,
  SUM(CASE WHEN roi >= baseline AND spend >= spend_base AND add_cost > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d3_cnt,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN roi >= baseline AND spend >= spend_base AND add_cost > 0 THEN add_cost ELSE 0 END),0) AS d3_addcost,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (roi < baseline OR spend < spend_base) AND add_cost = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d4_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN roi < 1.0 OR (spend >= 100 AND roi < baseline * 0.5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d6_cnt,

zhuigou_plan_5ab.sql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT TASK_ID, TASK_NAME, MAX(CONTROL_STAT) AS control_stat, MAX(BUDGET) AS budget,
    MAX(STAT_COST_FOR_OVERALL_ROI2_ASSIST) AS spend, MAX(TOTAL_PREPAY_AND_PAY_ORDER_ROI2_ASSIST) AS roi,
    MAX(PAY_ROI2_GOAL) AS goal, COUNT(*) AS mat_cnt
  FROM dbo.[千川素材数据_乘方_调控]
  WHERE DATE_TIME = (SELECT MAX(DATE_TIME) FROM dbo.[千川素材数据_乘方_调控])
  GROUP BY TASK_ID, TASK_NAME
)
SELECT TOP 40
  TASK_NAME,
  CASE WHEN control_stat NOT LIKE '%已暂停%' AND roi >= goal AND ABS(spend-budget) < 1 THEN '5A跑空-加预算'
       WHEN control_stat NOT LIKE '%已暂停%' AND roi < goal AND spend > 0 THEN '5B不良-立即停'
       WHEN control_stat NOT LIKE '%已暂停%' THEN '5C正常'
       ELSE '已暂停/终止' END AS plan_type,
  ROUND(goal,2) AS goal, ROUND(roi,2) AS roi, ROUND(spend,0) AS spend, ROUND(budget,0) AS budget, control_stat
FROM p
ORDER BY CASE WHEN control_stat NOT LIKE '%已暂停%' AND roi >= goal AND ABS(spend-budget) < 1 THEN 0 WHEN control_stat NOT LIKE '%已暂停%' AND roi < goal AND spend > 0 THEN 1 WHEN control_stat NOT LIKE '%已暂停%' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, spend DESC

SELECT CONVERT(varchar(10), STAT_TIME, 23) AS stat_date,
  SUM(STAT_COST_FOR_ROI2) AS spend,
  SUM(TOTAL_PAY_ORDER_GMV_INCLUDE_COUPON_FOR_ROI2) AS gmv,
  CASE WHEN SUM(STAT_COST_FOR_ROI2)=0 THEN 0
       ELSE SUM(TOTAL_PAY_ORDER_GMV_INCLUDE_COUPON_FOR_ROI2)/SUM(STAT_COST_FOR_ROI2) END AS roi
FROM dbo.千川素材数据_素材列表
WHERE ADVERTISER_ID IN (1746654623203336,1752918115978253,1762225330799629,1768848113872904,1776890866670605)
  AND STAT_TIME >= CONVERT(date, DATEADD(day,-13,GETDATE()))
GROUP BY STAT_TIME
ORDER BY STAT_TIME

weekly-material-top50.sql:
SELECT TOP 50
  CAST(MATERIAL_ID AS varchar(30)) AS material_id,
  MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(MATERIAL_NAME, ''), '未命名素材')) AS material_name,
  MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(MATERIAL_SOURCE, ''), '未知来源')) AS material_source,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(STAT_COST_FOR_ROI2, 0)), 2) AS spend,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(TOTAL_PAY_ORDER_GMV_INCLUDE_COUPON_FOR_ROI2, 0)), 2) AS gmv,
  SUM(COALESCE(TOTAL_PAY_ORDER_COUNT_FOR_ROI2, 0)) AS orders
FROM dbo.[千川素材数据_素材列表]
WHERE STAT_TIME >= '2026-08-12' AND STAT_TIME < '2026-08-19'
GROUP BY MATERIAL_ID
HAVING SUM(COALESCE(STAT_COST_FOR_ROI2, 0)) > 0
ORDER BY spend DESC
